import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def run(f,p0,name):
    best=None
    for s in range(12):
        rng=np.random.default_rng(s)
        p=np.array(p0)*(1+0.5*rng.standard_normal(len(p0))) if s>0 else np.array(p0,float)
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda q: f(q)-sigma, p, max_nfev=4000)
            if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
        except Exception: pass
    nm=np.mean((f(best.x)-sigma)**2)/np.var(sigma)
    print(name,"nmse=%.3e"%nm, np.round(best.x,4))
